name: Titan Circuits
old_description: Titan Circuits — a division of Outroar LLC — specializes in high-mix, low to medium volume electronic manufacturing services in the USA. We operate on the principal that quality is built into all of our processes. From beginning to end, quality is in the forefront. We are committed to providing cost-effective, high-quality PCB assembly services with superior customer service.
about:
Titan Circuits operates from Phoenix, Arizona, as a division of Outroar LLC. The company specializes in high-mix, low- to medium-volume electronic manufacturing services, focusing on printed circuit board assembly for customers across the United States and abroad.

Its core offering is PCB assembly, covering surface-mount technology down to 01005 passives, QFNs, BGAs, and micro-BGAs, through-hole and selective soldering, flexible and rigid-flex circuit assembly, box-build integration, cable and wire harness fabrication, and functional testing. The shop handles prototype runs through low- to medium-volume production, providing turnkey, consigned, and partially kitted supply-chain options.

The customer base spans military and defense (ITAR and SAM registered), aerospace (AS9100D certified, serving premier aerospace firms), medical (RoHS IPC Class 3 devices), automotive (power and RF boards for autonomous vehicles), industrial (control systems for harsh environments), and telecommunications (RF assemblies including Rogers/FR4 hybrids). Clients range from small startups to large global enterprises.

Titan Circuits emphasizes built-in quality, with staff certified to IPC-A-610G and IPC J-STD-001G with the Space Addendum, and a full-time IPC trainer on site. Recent equipment investments include a DEK Horizon Neo iX printer, dual-gantry Yamaha YSM20-2 pick-and-place machines, a BTU reflow oven, Koh Young Zenith 2 3D AOI, an Assure X-ray component counter, Nordson selective solder, and an Aqueous Zero Ion ionic contamination tester.
